title: 50 Pack 4 OZ Plastic Jars Round Clear Cosmetic Container with Black Lids, Eternal Moment Slime Jars for Lotion, Cream, Ointments, Makeup, Eye shadow, Rhinestone, Samples, Pot, Travel Storage
description:
About this item
★【SUPER VALUE PACK】: You will get 50 clear 4oz plastic containers with black lids, 50 labels for distinction and 5 spatulas for dispensing or mixing, used for anything you want to store. Personalized stickers/labels are ideal for business and promotional goods.
★【PREMIUM QUALITY】: These round plastic jars with lids are made of high-quality BPA Free PET material characteristized as high chemical resistance, high impact resistance and shatterproof. Round with straight sides, wide mouth and thick wall make it durable and easy to fill and take out.
★【PERFECT SIZE】: 4 fl. oz jars with lids, 2.32"/5.9cm in diameter, 2.48"/6.3cm in height. Perfect to fit in your handbag, store or display on a shelf, these attractive small containers with lids are ideal for promotional or resale merchandise.
★【LEAK PROOF AND AIRTIGHT】: The foam liner on the top lid creates an airtight seal that provides good protection for your items when the lid is securely screwed onto the container. You do not need to worry about leakage, especially when you carry them in your bags. See-through plastic jars with lids display your contents.
★【USEFUL CONTAINERS】: You can use these plastic jars with lids to store your DIY slime, homemade makeup, ingredients, lotions, body butter, face creams, eye shadow, oils, nails or other beauty products; they can also be used as containers for party favors, paint, jewelry, collectibles, other crafts, etc.

reviews_1s:
Beware there’s no way these little jars hold 4oz of anything… I’ve bought plenty of jars and never received a jar that fits in a 2 year olds hands , so now as a business owner I have to pay for another round of jars that actually hold 4 oz of product!These clear containers did not work for the job they were bought for as the quality was not good, they are very brittle. So I returned the 50 Pack 4 OZ Plastic Jars. They were delivered to their warehouse on January 10, 2025, but I still haven’t received my refund.If I could leave 0 stars, I would. These containers have some kind of chemical coating in them no matter how many times I washed them. I tried to put slime in them and as soon as it touched the inside of the containers, it melted. Almost like it FUSED to the plastic, and again, I washed them too. Now I’m poorer and I have all these useless containers that I can’t do anything with.I ordered 100 of these jars for sugar scrubs, under-filled them, kept them upright in locked handled containers for transport to a show, and even simply sitting on my tiered displays, many of them leaked. I do not feel confident shipping them, and many of the labels have been ruined. Unfortunately, what I thought would be a great option to bring my sugar scrubs back to the public, did not go as planned.do not purchase these jars. They do not hold 4 ounces as advertised. Amazon customer service sucks because they let people false advertise and then gives you are hard time to return.Click to play video
